outcomeNote: A single transmitted amoraic ruling attached to a mishna lemma; the difficulties on it open in the next unit.

segments.he: עֵרֶךְ יָדִי וְרַגְלִי עָלַי וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב גִּידֵּל אָמַר רַב: וְנוֹתֵן דָּמֶיהָ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that one who says: It is incumbent «upon me» to donate «the valuation of my forearm, or of my leg,» has not said anything, as there are valuations in the Torah only for a complete person. «Rav Giddel says» that «Rav says: And» although he is exempt from donating the valuation, «he must give the assessment» of the forearm or leg.

moves.about: Rav's ruling that such a vower nonetheless gives the assessment of the limb
